title: Netflix: Recommendations, Profiles, and Offline Downloads
description: Add recommendation algorithms, multiple profiles per account, and offline viewing.

data.text: Add personalized recommendations using watch history, support multiple profiles per account with separate watchlists, and allow offline downloads with expiry.

data.title: Profile and OfflineDownload
Why genre-based recommendations first?
data.text: Content-based filtering by genre is fast and explainable. 'Because you watched Sci-Fi' is intuitive. Matrix factorization and collaborative filtering come later when you have enough data.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Profile separates watchlists and history per user
OfflineDownload tracks expiry for license compliance
Recommendations start with genre affinity from history
data.takeaway: Netflix personalization starts with simple genre affinity. Profiles, downloads, and recommendations make the experience feel tailor-made.
